_meta.note: First-pass translations, not native-speaker-reviewed. English (en) and Indonesian (id) carry higher confidence given this codebase's existing Bali/Asia-Makassar context; Thai (th), Vietnamese (vi), and Tagalog (tl) are best-effort drafts and MUST be QA'd by a native/fluent speaker before shipping to any customer-facing surface. Do not treat th/vi/tl strings as production-verified.

invalid_phone_number.en: Please enter a valid phone number.
invalid_phone_number.th: กรุณากรอกหมายเลขโทรศัพท์ที่ถูกต้อง
invalid_phone_number.vi: Vui lòng nhập số điện thoại hợp lệ.
invalid_phone_number.tl: Mangyaring maglagay ng wastong numero ng telepono.

invalid_email.en: Please enter a valid email address.
invalid_email.th: กรุณากรอกอีเมลที่ถูกต้อง
invalid_email.vi: Vui lòng nhập địa chỉ email hợp lệ.
invalid_email.tl: Mangyaring maglagay ng wastong email address.

closing_ceiling_exceeded.en: This booking would end after closing time. Please choose an earlier start time.
closing_ceiling_exceeded.id: Pemesanan ini akan berakhir setelah jam tutup. Silakan pilih waktu mulai yang lebih awal.
closing_ceiling_exceeded.th: การจองนี้จะสิ้นสุดหลังเวลาปิดทำการ กรุณาเลือกเวลาเริ่มต้นที่เร็วขึ้น
closing_ceiling_exceeded.vi: Lịch đặt này sẽ kết thúc sau giờ đóng cửa. Vui lòng chọn giờ bắt đầu sớm hơn.
closing_ceiling_exceeded.tl: Ang booking na ito ay matatapos pagkalipas ng oras ng pagsara. Mangyaring pumili ng mas maagang oras ng simula.

before_opening.en: This time is before we open. Please choose a later start time.
before_opening.id: Waktu ini sebelum kami buka. Silakan pilih waktu mulai yang lebih siang.
before_opening.th: เวลานี้ก่อนเวลาเปิดทำการของเรา กรุณาเลือกเวลาเริ่มต้นที่ช้าลง
before_opening.vi: Thời gian này trước giờ mở cửa của chúng tôi. Vui lòng chọn giờ bắt đầu muộn hơn.
before_opening.tl: Ang oras na ito ay bago pa kami magbukas. Mangyaring pumili ng mas huling oras ng simula.

service_unavailable.id: Layanan ini saat ini tidak tersedia.
service_unavailable.th: บริการนี้ไม่พร้อมให้บริการในขณะนี้
service_unavailable.vi: Dịch vụ này hiện không khả dụng.
service_unavailable.tl: Kasalukuyang hindi available ang serbisyong ito.

billing_code_invalid.en: We couldn't recognize that booking code. Please check and try again.
billing_code_invalid.id: Kami tidak dapat mengenali kode pemesanan tersebut. Silakan periksa kembali.
billing_code_invalid.th: เราไม่สามารถจดจำรหัสการจองนั้นได้ กรุณาตรวจสอบอีกครั้ง
billing_code_invalid.vi: Chúng tôi không nhận ra mã đặt lịch đó. Vui lòng kiểm tra lại.
billing_code_invalid.tl: Hindi namin makilala ang booking code na iyan. Mangyaring suriin at subukan muli.

session_expired.en: Your session has expired. Please start again.
session_expired.id: Sesi Anda telah berakhir. Silakan mulai lagi.
session_expired.th: เซสชันของคุณหมดอายุแล้ว กรุณาเริ่มต้นใหม่
session_expired.vi: Phiên của bạn đã hết hạn. Vui lòng bắt đầu lại.
session_expired.tl: Nag-expire na ang iyong session. Mangyaring magsimula muli.

needs_clarification.en: We couldn't confirm your reply. A team member will follow up shortly.
needs_clarification.id: Kami tidak dapat mengonfirmasi balasan Anda. Tim kami akan segera menghubungi Anda.
needs_clarification.th: เราไม่สามารถยืนยันคำตอบของคุณได้ ทีมงานจะติดต่อกลับในไม่ช้า
needs_clarification.vi: Chúng tôi không thể xác nhận phản hồi của bạn. Đội ngũ hỗ trợ sẽ liên hệ sớm.
needs_clarification.tl: Hindi namin makumpirma ang iyong sagot. Makikipag-ugnayan sa iyo ang aming team sa lalong madaling panahon.
